200-MILE USAC NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP STOCK CAR RACE
Sanction No. 56-SC-27
Thursday, August 23, 1956
Purse: $5,000.00 Against 40% of Gate Receipts after Tax Deductions
Track: WISCONSIN STATE FAIR PARK-1 MILE PAVED
Mail Original Entry to: Wisconsin Auto Racing, Inc., 1200 S. First St., Milwaukee, Wis.
Mail Duplicate Entry to: George Holck, 2724 S. Fulton St., Milwaukee, Wis.
ENTRIES CLOSING DATE, MIDNIGHT, AUGUST 17, 1956
NOVICE DRIVERS Must Pass Test Before Qualifying Trials
CARS ELIGIBLE-—Entries will be restricted to 1954, 55 and 56 Models of American Manufacture.
Any hardtop model is eligible, except Commercial Cars, Jeeps and Station Wagons.
CARS MUST BE STOCK -No changes or alterations except as provided by the rules and regulations.
STARTING FIELD —The right is reserved by the USAC Officials and Management to increase the
field of starters at their discretion. The fastest thirty (30) qualified cars will be selected first for the
starting field.
If more than 30 cars are permitted to start (limit 40 cars), those cars finishing below 30th position will
receive $2o.00 each. This money will be deducted from the total purse.

QUALIFYING TRIALS -Start at 11:30 A. M. Day of Race and stop at 2:00 P. M. Right is reserved
to extend the qualifying time by the USAC Officials and the Management at their discretion.
RACE STARTS AT 3:00 P. M. (Central Standard Time). Cars must be in lineup at 2:30 P. M. USAC
Technical Committee reserves the right to judge and decide what constitutes a strictly stock car. CARS
WILL NOT be permitted to qualify until inspected by the Technical Committee and an Okay card is
attached to car.
IMPORTANT —Send in your entry before the DEADLINE date, Midnight, August 17, 1956.
